liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (3 reviews): The jam lasted forty-seven minutes, a notable highlight of the evening; The jam builds to multiple dissonant crescendos, filling the entire side A [15][16][17]
- **It Must Have Been The Roses** (1 review): Jerry Garcia delivers a great version of this song [17]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The source notes a great performance of this track [17]
- **Money Money** (1 review): The source singles out a rare performance of this track [15]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): The listener remembers this song screaming in their dreams to this day [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-05-21.sbd.matrix.tobin.87114.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 198 min; rated 4.55/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd-patched.wier.22801.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 197 min; rated 4.11/5 by 18 [2]. Said about its sound: The other soundboard source has much better sound quality; The recording has a little noise but is dynamically and sonically thrilling [22][24]
- **gd1974-05-21.aud-fixed.tobin.87143.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 25 songs; 198 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1974-05-21.150950.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 189 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [7]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd.belkin.2597.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 183 min; rated 4.52/5 by 23 [9]. Said about its sound: Crowd cheering is audible as the band prepares to finish the jam; Keith's piano is mixed in nicely, unlike typical recordings; The show is very high quality both musically and soundwise [23][25]

## Around the show

- A seven-year-old attended the show in Seattle with their stepbrother [26]
- The listener prefers this performance to the June 18th Grow to Other One [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-05-21.sbd.matrix.tobin.87114.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (65%-SBD/35%-AUD) [1]. Also: Recorded by Pat Lee using Sony ECM18N mics and a Sony 152SD deck; Playin' In The Band is patched with twenty-six seconds of audience audio; David Minches performed the A/D conversion using a Nakamichi Dragon [1]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd-patched.wier.22801.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charles Wier; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: This source lacks Stella Blue and two versions of Around & Around [22]
- **gd1974-05-21.aud-fixed.tobin.87143.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Sony ECM18N mics > Sony 152SD deck recorded by Pat Lee, hand held mics in right balcony (patched version of shn id 10150 see info file for details) [4]
- **gd1974-05-21.150950.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Patt Lee; transferred by Matt Smith, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Pat Lee's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM18N mics (hand held, right balcony) > Sony 152SD [7]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd.belkin.2597.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]. Also: The listener possessed the recording on a Maxell cassette for some time; The download is missing Stella Blue and Around & Around tracks; The listed Around & Around is actually Big River [16][21]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1974-05-21 Edmundson Pavilion, U. of Washington, Seattle, WA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1974-05-21-edmundson-pavilion-u-of-washington-seattle-wa-usa/) [28]
- Fan art by blackmuddyblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - Pacific Northwest 1973-1974: The Complete Recordings](https://blackmuddyblog.blogspot.com/2018/09/grateful-dead-pacific-northwest-1973.html) [29]
